content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your recent rides were both aerobic: 90 minutes on July 1 (Load 55) and 2 hours on July 3 (Load 85), each at 0.70 Intensity. Current Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, and Form +7 suggest you’re fresh enough for one controlled quality day followed by endurance.

**Saturday — Sweet spot, 75 minutes**  
Warmup: 15min progressive, 50–70% FTP  
Main: 3×12min at 88–92% FTP, 5min at 50–60% between  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: Intensity 0.80–0.83, Load 60–70  
Why: Adds sustained aerobic pressure without an aggressive jump from your recent endurance riding.

**Sunday — Endurance, 2 hours**  
Warmup: 10min at 50–65% FTP  
Main: 100min at 60–72% FTP, conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: Intensity 0.65–0.70, Load 85–100  
Why: Builds aerobic volume while keeping the weekend repeatable.

If your resting HR is elevated or sleep is under six hours going into Saturday, replace the sweet spot work with easy endurance.
